dct_title_s: GRID3 COD - Nord-Kivu - Geospatial Data Layers
dct_description_sm: The GRID3 COD - Nord-Kivu - Geospatial Data Layers 20260731 provides geospatial layers for Nord-Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, including: Settlement names, Health facilities, Health zones, and Health areas. This data package supersedes the v8.0 GRID3 COD health areas, health facilities, health zones, and settlement names layers for Nord-Kivu Province only. It does not supersede versions of these layers for other provinces or geographies. This dataset may contain unintended omissions, as it was developed under a compressed timeline to enable timely information sharing and support teams engaged in emergency response efforts. This dataset should be considered operational; it has not been fully validated by government authorities. Its production is part of ongoing work, and additional edits and refinements are expected in future releases. Dataset citation Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University, Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévention, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and GRID3. 2026. GRID3 COD - Nord-Kivu - Geospatial Data Layers 20260731. New York: Columbia University. https://data.humdata.org/dataset/grid3-cod-nord-kivu-geospatial-data-layers. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR. Contacts and data queries The authors of this dataset appreciate feedback regarding the data, including suggestions, discovery of errors, difficulties in using the data, and format preferences. For dataset-related questions, please send an email to: info@ciesin.columbia.edu
